description: This file defines classes and functions for performance testing, including metrics collection, test execution, output parsing, and test factory creation. It is part of a performance testing framework for web rendering or layout tests.

classes.name: PerfTestMetric
classes.description: Represents a performance test metric, including its name, unit, and collected iteration values.

classes.name: PerfTest
classes.description: Base class for running performance tests, parsing output, and collecting metrics.

classes.name: SingleProcessPerfTest
classes.description: Subclass of PerfTest for single-process performance tests.

classes.name: ChromiumStylePerfTest
classes.description: Subclass of PerfTest for Chromium-style performance tests with specific output parsing.

classes.name: PerfTestFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create appropriate PerfTest subclasses based on test name patterns.

methods.name: PerfTestMetric.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a performance metric with name, unit, and optional iterations.

methods.name: PerfTest.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a performance test with port, name, path, and runner count.

methods.name: PerfTest.run
methods.description: Runs the performance test multiple times and collects metrics.

methods.name: PerfTest.parse_and_log_output
methods.description: Parses the output of a test run and logs results.

methods.name: PerfTest._run_with_driver
methods.description: Executes the test with a driver and processes output lines.

methods.name: ChromiumStylePerfTest.run
methods.description: Runs a Chromium-style performance test and parses the output.
